name: Charles Kuribayashi
source:
Patisserie.

A Half French sweets lover. He heard the shop was looking for a confectionery maker, but it wasn't until after that he learned it was supposed to be for Japanese confections.

With a gentle smile and calm attitude he's a a soothing presence to everybody.
But when his emotions run wild he can explode.
